Class.summary: Controller responsible for user management operations including searching, retrieving, creating, and updating accounts. Restricted to administrators only.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.

GetUsers.summary: Retrieves a paginated and filterable list of all registered users.
GetUsers.param: The search, role filter, and pagination query parameters.
GetUsers.returns: A paginated collection of user summary response DTOs.
GetUsers.response: Returns the paginated list of users.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.

GetUserById.summary: Retrieves detailed information for a specific user by their unique identifier.
GetUserById.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user.
GetUserById.response: If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.
If the user with the specified ID does not exist.

CreateUser.summary: Creates a new user account with a specified role.
CreateUser.remarks: Administrators can provision Admin, SupportAgent, or Customer accounts directly.
CreateUser.param: User creation payload containing email, displayName, initial password, and role.
CreateUser.returns: The created user details response DTO.
CreateUser.response: If the input payload fails validation or identity password rules.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.
If an account with the specified email already exists.

UpdateUser.summary: Updates the profile and active status of an existing user.
UpdateUser.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user to update.
The updated user details (DisplayName, IsActive status).
UpdateUser.returns: The updated user details response DTO.
UpdateUser.response: If update payload is invalid or identity update fails.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.
If the user with the specified ID does not exist.

GetAgents.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of active Support Agents.
GetAgents.remarks: Commonly used by ticket assignment dropdowns and workload assignment interfaces.
GetAgents.param: The number of agents per page (defaults to 10).
GetAgents.returns: A paginated list of support agent profiles.
GetAgents.response: Returns the paginated list of agents.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.
